learning_objective: 🎯 We will explore a fun piece about a frog, learn about its pond habitat, and enjoy reading with rhythm and happy sounds!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: The chapter shows us where the little green frog lives. He loves spending his day sitting on lily pads and watching the water.
Frogs have very strong back legs. We get to read about how the frog hops around and makes big jumps into the air.
When the rain falls, the frog gets very happy. He makes loud croaking sounds like he is singing a song for the rain.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Leap Frog Race
fun_activity.instructions: Pretend to be a frog and see how far you can jump from a starting line. Try to make a funny croak sound every time you land!

quick_recap: ⭐ The frog loves to live in the cool, wet pond.
⭐ He uses his strong legs to hop and jump everywhere.
⭐ Frogs love the rain and sing by making loud croaking sounds.
